findings.title: Verified typed claims exceed the retained source support
evidence: The Coca-Cola amount envelope asserts scholarship='achievement-based' as verified, but neither coca.md nor its bound excerpt contains that description.
CSKT materials asserts signedDatedForms=true; the retained passage says paperwork must be signed and completed, without the dated qualifier.

CSKT materials compresses completion evidence to diplomaGEDHiSET=true, omitting the retained certificate-or-test-results alternative and the 2026-graduate diploma-or-transcript-after-graduation condition.
findings.impact: The selected artifacts and matching excerpts pass structural checks while failing to support every verified component and substantive materials alternative.
findings.authorFix: Restore exact substantive non-contact passages only if already available from the original in-session conversion, or mark unsupported components unknown. findings.title: Typed eligibility omits prospective enrollment alternatives
evidence: Fisher explicitly permits students enrolled OR planning to enroll in the stated full-time program.
Gates explicitly requires students to plan to enroll full-time.
The corresponding typed values retain fullTime and program properties but omit these enrollment modalities.
findings.impact: Later consumers could interpret the typed conditions as requiring current enrollment and incorrectly narrow high-school eligibility.
findings.authorFix: Explicitly encode Fisher's enrolled-or-planning alternative and Gates' plan-to-enroll condition in held typed values and semantic assertions. Carry the distinction into README and focused verifier checks.

findings.title: NESA award-period membership is incorrectly scoped only to Cooke terms
evidence: Award Condition1 requires active NESA membership for each award period for the offered scholarship generally.
Award Condition3 separately imposes the Cooke four-year bachelor-program requirement.
The typed renewal envelope combines active membership with CookeFourYearTerms; initial NESAMember=true does not preserve the general award-period continuation scope.
findings.impact: The held representation loses a general continuing award condition and makes it appear Cooke-specific.
findings.authorFix: Represent active NESA membership for each award period as a general condition, separate from Cooke-specific bachelor enrollment. Preserve general full-time maintenance/proof and course-schedule payment conditions, with Cooke transcript verification separately scoped. Update semantic assertions, README and focused verifier checks.

locations: All dependent CSKT PDF evidence excerpts

POLICY.md excludes unrelated contact values before persistence.
findings.impact: Sanitization is incomplete despite the documented exclusion of contact values.
findings.authorFix: Remove the remaining extension from the selected artifact and dependent excerpts. Update hashes, concordance and receipts; disclose the additional redaction without claiming historical output was erased.
